input.title: new tool families must be config gated
input.what_went_wrong: A new tool family was registered unconditionally in the tool registry, so every session paid for it even when the feature was unwanted.
input.rule_for_next_time: Register every new tool family behind an explicit config flag that defaults to off, and assert both the on and the off case in the registry test.
input.description: new tool families must be config gated
